# graylog_grok_pattern (Resource)

Manages a Graylog grok pattern.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graylog_grok_pattern" "example" {
  name    = "TFEXAMPLEPATTERN"
  pattern = "foo(?<bar>.*)"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `pattern` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
